source_metadata.title: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in Cat and Owner

extraction_limitations: The PDF page image contains material from adjacent letters; extraction was bounded to the article titled Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in Cat and Owner, spanning journal pages 1998-2000.
The report is a single-household case report/letter and does not provide a denominator suitable for incidence or risk estimation.
The owner’s earlier skin abscesses and pneumonia were not microbiologically tested.
The timing of paired sampling cannot establish direction of transmission.
Additional characterization of the isolates was not performed; SCCmec IVa/ST8 attributes discussed in the letter were sourced from prior literature, not measured in this case.
No study-specific figures or tables were present; the figure visible on journal page 1998 belongs to the preceding letter and was excluded.
